scope: Standalone procedural identity-condition search; Obtainable only

bootstrap.method: Paired percentile cluster bootstrap, central 95%; no multiplicity adjustment

denominator: Every planned attempted episode, including invalid selections, failed submissions and abstentions

definitions.chain_grounded_correct: Correct source label, finite-world evidence identification and localized identity chain with diagnostic visible-mask coverage
definitions.localized_grounded_correct: Chain-correct with the additional diagnostic rectangle IoU/precision thresholds
definitions.evidence_found: Actual observed view hashes identify one source label in the finite world bank
definitions.duplicate_requests: Executed requests beyond the first request for each public view in the same episode
definitions.efficiency: All-attempt means; adaptive selector model calls count, scripted selectors generate no model tokens
definitions.tokens: Offered native input tokens and all generated tokens; unavailable if any transport accounting is incomplete

interpretation.completion_vs_grounding: A valid finish is reported separately from physical-label agreement, acquired evidence, and complete localized identity chains.
interpretation.training_scope: Existing checkpoints are evaluated on a new procedural pilot; these results do not establish a general harmful effect of post-training.
interpretation.small_pilot: 16 cases from eight paired scene banks, not the 116-case program holdout.
interpretation.interface_separation: The RGB program and finite-choice assisted interfaces are not included in these native scores.
interpretation.terminal_action_mismatch: A request_photo or compare call at the required final-answer stage is a terminal action mismatch, not necessarily malformed JSON or a visual error.
